caption: The drawing depicts a large, funnel-shaped metallic object with a wide, shallow rim tapering inward to a circular hole at the bottom center. The object has a series of evenly divided segments radiating out from the inner hole to the edge, and there is a wedge-shaped section cut out from the rim and bent upwards, exposing the rim’s thickness. The object sits at a slight angle and features a small handle or peg protruding from one side of the rim, and a looped handle attached to the base. The color palette consists primarily of muted, blended shades of gray, beige, and subtle hints of brown and green, giving the object a matte metallic appearance. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a small annotated diagram in red showing a top-down view of the object with a measurement (3/8) and arrows indicating direction. The background is a flat, light beige color with no additional features.
title: Tin Bath Tub
